name: Sidon

queries.query: Lebanon official cadastral parcel map viewer Sidon Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre
queries.result: First-party discovery found the General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre (DLRC) site, its official paid title-register service, and the registry/cadastre office directory naming the Sidon–Jezzine registry office and South cadastral office. No open first-party parcel-geometry viewer or anonymous parcel API was found.

queries.query: لبنان صيدا خريطة عقارية السجل العقاري المساحة
queries.result: First-party Arabic DLRC results identify أمانة السجل العقاري في صيدا – جزين and دائرة المساحة في الجنوب. Arabic commercial map results claim parcel-map coverage in Sidon, but disclaim legal/official status and were not used as authoritative parcel evidence.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: General Directorate of Land Registry and Cadastre, Ministry of Finance, Lebanese Republic; the official directory names أمانة السجل العقاري في صيدا – جزين and دائرة المساحة في الجنوب.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalOrStateContext: The DLRC is the national Lebanese land-registry/cadastre authority. Its public title-register workflow requires province, caza, cadastral zone, and parcel number and charges for viewing title-register documents.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: Official DLRC pages and the current payment.lrc.gov.lb workflow were fetched anonymously. The official service exposes a paid title-register form, not parcel polygons or a documented open geometry endpoint.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: A local Sidon registry office and regional cadastral office are explicitly evidenced by the first-party DLRC directory; this does not prove an open parcel feature service or runtime integration.

schemaAndCrs.endpoint: Lebanese Ministry of Public Health ArcGIS REST Feature Layer 4, named Cadaster under Administrative_Zones; administrative-zone layer, not a parcel layer.
schemaAndCrs.responseType: ArcGIS JSON metadata and GeoJSON query response were available.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Service native WKID 102100 / latest WKID 3857; bounded query requested output WKID 4326.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: ID (GUID) and OID are native fields for the returned administrative-zone feature; they are not treated as parcel identities.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite key used or inferred.
schemaAndCrs.schemaEvidence: Layer metadata declares name Cadaster, fields ID/OID/NAME/NAME_AR/PCODE/STATUS, and a polygon geometry; it does not expose parcel-number fields or parcel-level semantics.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: The preserved exact WUP point [33.549733669263, 35.380906250917] was queried without coordinate shifting. The government administrative-zone layer returned one containing polygon named Saida Ed-Dekermane / صيدا الدكرمان, but this is not parcel geometry and was not retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official DLRC registry/cadastre offices and paid title-register lookup; separate Ministry of Public Health administrative-zone layer covers Lebanon administrative cadastral zones.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Only administrative-zone metadata and one exact-point administrative-zone response were verified; no parcel-level geometry response was obtained.

serialReviewerQualification: required; research evidence is not source integration or admission
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude ordering were preserved; no coordinate shift was used to force a hit.
The exact-point government response is an administrative cadastral-zone polygon, not evidence of a parcel hit or citywide parcel coverage.
No raw source-specific attribute set, parcel geometry, or synthetic identity is retained.
No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disablement was used.
The paid title-register workflow was not submitted and no title-register or ownership data was requested.
uncertainty: A first-party local registry/cadastre custodian is established, but no open anonymous parcel geometry service was discovered. Commercial Sidon map products may contain parcel maps, yet their legal disclaimers and lack of first-party service qualification prevent using them for source admission. Runtime remains held.
